title: Modulo torsion and integral Fourier formulas
as_he_states: Are the displayed character/Chern formulas really true modulo torsion? The final line also asks for an integral algebraic-cycle lift of a rational coefficient.
plausible_today: Separate three questions: the corrected Chern classes of one transformed bundle; integrality of its explicitly displayed multiple; and preservation ofCH/torsion by the Fourier transform for all classes. SpecifyGr and the coefficient ring before claiming equivalence.
state_of_art: The first two restricted ample-field statements follow from actual Chern classes; the literal expanded coefficient is refuted by the degree(1, 2) elliptic product. Beckmann and de Gaay Fortman(2023), Theorem3.8, equate several integral lifting properties in the principally polarized symmetric-line-bundle setting; Question3.9 records the general problem. Hasan etal.(2025), §§3–5, work over a smooth quasi-projective base with characteristic0/liftability/base-change hypotheses and coefficientsZ[1/(2g+d+1)!]. Status as of 19 November 2026: substantial partial results, no blanket integral theorem.
why_open: The exact filtration is not defined on the page. The later references explain denominator/torsion difficulties; they do not document why Grothendieck dropped this question.
worth: Worth a bounded run to compare the exact manuscript integrality multiple with the modern minimal-cycle criterion; avoid launching the general integral Fourier problem as a few-hour task.
